correctness.rationale: Independent bounded reproduction: run python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce-4.py. Enumerate all 2^10 spoke subsets; after their endpoints are removed, the remaining graph consists of unbroken cycles or paths cut from the outer decagon and two inner pentagons. An odd path or odd cycle has no perfect matching, an even path has one, and an even unbroken cycle has two. This exhausts and separates the 36 full matchings. For every deletion subset of each size 0–5, the bitwise union of edge incidence masks marks exactly the matchings destroyed; a one-bit complement gives the unique survivor. Examined respectively 1, 30, 435, 4060, 27405, 142506 subsets, with unique-survivor counts 0, 0, 0, 0, 240, 7272. The first size and its multiplicity, stratified by complement cycle lengths, are ((20),4,8):30 and ((5,5,10),5,22):6. Each minimum set is assigned to only one matching by uniqueness, so the class totals are 240 and 132. An adjacency-preserving permutation enumeration also gives 120 automorphisms and exactly those classes as the two orbits. The frozen scripts and their recorded outputs were inspected as separate evidence, not executed.
